surface.entry: DingTalkIngress.acceptTrustedCallback on an isolated PostgreSQL 64711 cluster, then AgentRuntime.advance
surface.goal: 请帮我制定一份支付服务回滚演练的推进方案，包含步骤、依赖、风险和验证方式
surface.provider: Synthetic GLM SSE provider; no real model or DingTalk credentials
surface.delivery: DeliveryGateway with a synthetic sendReply; proactive sending throws

behavior.planDelivered: A CONVERSATION plan whose text contains steps, dependencies, risks, validation and an explicit no-change statement completes through the separate tool-free narrative review, is delivered once to the requesting user, and creates no tool_actions, approvals or non-RUN outbox rows.
behavior.executedClaimRejected: A CONVERSATION plan claiming the rollback drill was already executed is rejected three times with UNBACKED_ACTION_PROSE even though the narrative review returned GENERAL; the run ends PARTIAL with result null and no delivery.
behavior.futurePromiseRejected: A CONVERSATION plan promising daily monitoring and notifications is rejected three times with UNBACKED_ACTION_PROSE; the run ends PARTIAL with result null, no delivery and finalResultAllowed false.

cases: a requested work plan is delivered as steps, dependencies, risks and validation without executing it
a plan claiming the work was already executed is rejected and never delivered
a plan promising future monitoring and notifications is rejected and never delivered

isolation.note: Original 90 project files plus the approved added files; the new T044 file is listed in approvedAddedFiles.

mutationCheck.observed: Both refusal tests fail: the executed-claim plan reaches the approved finalization after a single generation and is accepted as deliverable, so the expected three UNBACKED_ACTION_PROSE rejections and PARTIAL outcome never occur.

requirementsFull.note: 36 R items remain IN_PROGRESS and 14 catalog cases remain NOT_RUN; T044 is no longer among the errors (previously 51).

notProven: No live DingTalk single-chat delivery was exercised.
No live GLM request or response was exercised.
No real execution, release, monitoring or notification system was contacted.
The prose guard is a bounded pattern complement, not a general semantic proof of non-execution.
T044 remains NOT_RUN and R16 remains IN_PROGRESS; live acceptance remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
